purpose: Grant of Gullaṃtaṅga village as an agrahāra with immunities (including labor service for conduit maintenance and transfer of fines) to the āryabhikṣusaṅgha of Śivadeva-vihāra for the upkeep of water conduits (mahāpraṇālī)
notes: Issued from the Bhadrādhivāsa palace. No dūtaka is named before the date line. Vihāra names mentioned in defining boundary markers (Śrī-Mānadeva-vihāra, Kharjūrikā-vihāra, Madhyama-vihāra, Abhayaruci-vihāra, Vārta-Kalyāṇagupta-vihāra, Caturbhālaṭasana-vihāra, Śrīrāja-vihāra) and the beneficiary Śivadeva-vihāra are institutions/monasteries and not listed as individual persons.
